headline: Binance Halts Withdrawals Amid Suspected $5.3 Billion Hack
summary: Binance halted user withdrawals following a suspected $5.3 billion security breach and billions in outflows. The cryptocurrency exchange instituted emergency asset freezes while investigating, stating that user funds remain secure.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Disruptions and security breaches at major centralized exchanges pose systemic risks across the digital asset ecosystem.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Fears over exchange solvency and large-scale asset liquidation cause rapid selloffs across major digital tokens.
